claims.claim: Camtek's 2025 annual filing quantifies AI-cycle exposure: about 50% of revenue was generated by products supporting AI applications, making the durability of AI/HBM/advanced-packaging capex a material downside variable.
Geographic concentration is material: 91% of 2025 revenue came from Asia-Pacific and 49% from China, increasing sensitivity to regional demand, trade restrictions and geopolitical disruption.

Competitive pressure is structurally credible rather than manufactured: Camtek identifies larger global competitors and lower-priced local competitors that can pressure prices, margins, payment terms and cash flow.

risks: pricing and margin pressure from global and regional competitors

contradictions.contradiction: Strong AI-driven demand and bottleneck relevance coexist with unusually high exposure to the same AI capex cycle and Asia-Pacific geography that enable current growth.

unknowns: how much competitive pricing pressure is embedded in current forward orders
falsifiers: Sustained non-AI revenue diversification would reduce AI-cycle concentration risk.
Material geographic diversification outside Asia-Pacific would reduce regional concentration risk.

assist.changedStrategy: Used the annual regulatory risk-factor source to quantify AI/geographic concentration and competitive downside instead of repeating order-momentum evidence.
